video.title: Golden State Warriors Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

summary: Josh Lloyd previews the Golden State Warriors for fantasy and calls the roster bad. He thinks the season could be a throwaway: Jimmy Butler (ACL) and Moses Moody (patella) are out, Kristaps Porzingis has an unclear illness, and Steph Curry's knee is a worry. Steph is still a strong category player but much worse in points leagues, and he may lose minutes or get rest if the team struggles. Brandin Podziemski is his top target. Yaxel Lendeborg, Gui Santos and De'Anthony Melton are flyers, and Charles Bassey is a stash or streamer in deep formats. Porzingis is his biggest fade, and he would only take Butler very late with a plan to drop him.

rules.text: Players can be worth very different amounts in category leagues and points leagues. Check the format before drafting at ADP.

rules.text: Ranges for stars on bad teams should include risk, not just per-game value. Bad teams may rest stars and cut their minutes.
rules.quote: ranges that I've got like 20 to 30 for categories and 35 to 45 for points is not all just per game.

rules.text: Do not trust the 'most NBA ready' story for older rookies. They are usually older because they are not as good as younger prospects.
rules.quote: Older rookies usually are older rookies because they're not as good as the younger players.

rules.text: Value depends on context. In weekly leagues, older players are less appealing. Deep leagues make late picks worth it, while in 10-team leagues you can skip them.
rules.quote: you're talking weekly leagues, you don't want an older guy as much. You go deeper into a 16 teamer

rules.text: Players with uncertain availability fit roto, deep, big-bench and games-cap leagues. In standard formats, a roster spot that plays two games a week hurts streaming.
rules.quote: But that churning that roster spot where he might get two games a week for three months

rules.text: If you stash a long-term injured player late, drop him as soon as you need the injury slot. Do not give up streaming to hold him.
rules.quote: Sit here and promise to me that as soon as you need that injured slot, you drop him.

rules.text: Backup centers who start when the starters sit can be elite streamers.
rules.quote: and they have no Quinton Post, so he will be elite as a streamer.
